title: route.leave
description: WORLD_SESSIONS_PLAN §2.7, D9 (WS1): the body is nowhere in zone `zone` while the hidden player stands on that zone's route map (after a rejoin at the clearing, a blackout's Pokémon Center, a reload): gen1-bridge walks the hidden player home through the route's own back warp (the step script's path), which arrives as an ordinary warp. Answered act.result{kind:"route.leave", ok, reason?}: not_on_route (the hidden player is on no route map of that zone), busy (the world can't take the warp now: ask again), failed.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
